Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
function validate() {
    var memNum = document.getElementById("mem_num");
    var passwd = document.getElementById("passwd");
    var memNumRegEx = /^\d+$/;
    var passwdRegEx = /.....+/;
    if (!memNum.value.match(memNumRegEx)) {
        alert("Please enter a number only!");
        memNum.focus();
        return false;
    }
    if (!passwd.value.match(passwdRegEx)) {
        alert("Please enter a password longer than 4 chars!");
        passwd.focus();
        return false;
    }
}
